about: The company file's edit actions (tico.company.yaml, format 0.2). Each action's input_schema is a strict JSON schema; `limits` and `vocabulary` are what backend/company_file checks besides the schema. A tool-use model gets `actions` as its tools.

rules.label: Send email or messages outside the company
Spend money or start a paid plan
Delete data or close an account
Invite people or change who has access

review.label: A person reviews each draft before it goes out
Two checks before code ships or anything goes public
Spot checks: bots act inside the rules, a person reviews weekly

actions.name: company_set
actions.description: Set the company's name, what it does, or the signals read from it.

about.description: What the company does, in the visitor's words

signals.description: Every signal that applies (replaces the list)

actions.name: bot_add
actions.description: Add a bot to the chart from one of Tico's role templates, with the reason in the visitor's terms.

template.description: The role template's slug or name

reason.description: Why, tied to what the visitor said

title.description: A title other than the template's name, e.g. "Reviewer 1"

actions.name: bot_remove
actions.description: Remove one bot from the chart. BotOps itself stays.

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

actions.name: bot_rename
actions.description: Give a bot a new title.

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

actions.name: bot_set_reports_to
actions.description: Set who a bot reports to: a person, another bot, or "you" (the owner).

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

to.description: A person's or bot's id or name, or "you"

actions.name: bot_set_start
actions.description: Mark a bot to start now or later.

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

actions.name: bot_set_routine
actions.description: Set a bot's first routine: what it does on a schedule, in a few words.

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

routine.description: e.g. "Weekly deal review · Mondays at 09:00 team time"

actions.name: bot_set_first_job
actions.description: Pick the one first job: the bot that does one real task soon after setup, and the task. Moves the marker from any other bot.

bot.description: The bot: its id on the chart (or its exact title)

actions.name: team_remove
actions.description: Remove a whole team from the chart in one change (its bots; the visitor's own agents stay).

actions.name: goal_add
actions.description: Add a goal: a title in the visitor's words, its owner, and how it is measured when known: the measure, unit and direction, then target and deadline (baseline if known), or min and max for a range.

title.description: The goal in the visitor's words

owner.description: A person's or bot's id or name, or "you". A person not on the team yet is added.

measure.description: What is counted, e.g. "wholesale accounts". Leave it out until the visitor has said which number and by when; the goal then shows its measure as not set yet. "" clears it.

direction.description: Which way is better: up, down, or range (stay between min and max)

baseline.description: Today's number, if the visitor knows it (up or down)

deadline.description: When (up or down): a date (2027-03-01) or words like "March 1", "by the end of June", "in 90 days"

actions.name: goal_edit
actions.description: Change a goal's title, owner or measure. Measure fields given replace the old measure; measure "" clears it.

measure.description: What is counted, e.g. "wholesale accounts". Leave it out until the visitor has said which number and by when; the goal then shows its measure as not set yet. "" clears it.

direction.description: Which way is better: up, down, or range (stay between min and max)

baseline.description: Today's number, if the visitor knows it (up or down)

deadline.description: When (up or down): a date (2027-03-01) or words like "March 1", "by the end of June", "in 90 days"

actions.name: goal_remove
actions.description: Remove a goal.

actions.name: person_set
actions.description: Add a person, or change one already on the team.

person.description: The id of the person to change; leave out to add someone

owner.description: They own the company and sit at the top of the chart

actions.name: agent_set
actions.description: Add an AI agent the company already runs, or change one already on the chart.

agent.description: The id of the agent to change; leave out to add one

actions.name: rules_set_never
actions.description: Set what never happens without a person (replaces the list).

never.description: The rules that need a person

actions.name: rules_set_review
actions.description: Set how much review happens before something goes out.

actions.name: rules_use_defaults
actions.description: Go back to Tico's default rules and tools.

actions.name: tools_set
actions.description: Pick the tools to connect after setup (replaces the list). Never ask for passwords or keys.

actions.name: step_go
actions.description: Move to one of the five tabs.

actions.name: undo
actions.description: Undo BotOps's last change.
